diplomaincplusplusandpythonprogramming.human_name: Diploma in C++ and Python Programming
diplomaincplusplusandpythonprogramming.description_text: Build a strong foundation in two powerful programming languages with this dual-focused diploma course. Learn core programming concepts, syntax, and problem-solving techniques in both C++ and Python, comparing their strengths and applications. Through structured lessons and practical exercises, you'll develop versatile coding skills, understand key programming paradigms, and gain a well-rounded foundation for further study or entry into software development.

spatialdatavisualizationandmachinelearni.human_name: Spatial Data Visualization And Machine Learning In Python
spatialdatavisualizationandmachinelearni.description_text: Explore the intersection of spatial data, visualization, and machine learning in this specialized Python course. Learn how to work with geographic and spatial datasets, create insightful visualizations, and apply machine learning techniques to spatial problems. You'll gain hands-on experience with mapping data, identifying patterns, and building models that incorporate location-based information, equipping you with in-demand skills for geospatial analytics and data science roles.

diplomainpythonprogramming.description_text: Earn a recognized diploma while mastering Python programming from the basics to intermediate concepts. Learn syntax, data structures, control flow, functions, and object-oriented programming principles through structured lessons and practical exercises. You'll develop strong problem-solving skills, understand how to write maintainable code, and gain a well-rounded understanding of Python's core capabilities. This diploma course is designed for learners wanting formal, structured training to kickstart a career in programming or software development.

pythonprogramming_beginnertoexpert.description_text: Take your Python skills from zero to advanced with this comprehensive course covering the entire learning journey. Master fundamentals like variables, loops, and functions before progressing to object-oriented programming, file handling, error handling, and modules. Through practical projects, you'll develop the ability to write clean, efficient code, debug programs confidently, and apply Python to real-world problems. This course is ideal for learners seeking a complete, structured path toward becoming a proficient Python developer.

generativeaiforbeginners_futureofinnovat.human_name: Generative AI for Beginners: Future of Innovation Unlocked
generativeaiforbeginners_futureofinnovat.description_text: Discover the fundamentals of generative AI and its transformative potential in this beginner-friendly course. Learn how generative AI models work, explore key concepts and terminology, and understand real-world applications across industries. You'll gain insight into how AI tools generate text, images, and other content, developing a strong conceptual foundation for exploring this rapidly evolving field, whether for career growth or personal curiosity.

pythondjangotraining.description_text: Learn to build powerful, scalable web applications using Django, Python's leading web framework. Cover essential concepts including models, views, templates, URL routing, and database integration while developing real projects. You'll gain hands-on experience creating dynamic websites, managing user authentication, and structuring applications following best practices, equipping you with practical skills for professional Python web development.

pythonwebscraping_dataextractionwithbeau.human_name: Python Web Scraping: Data Extraction with Beautiful Soup
pythonwebscraping_dataextractionwithbeau.description_text: Learn how to extract valuable data from websites using Python and Beautiful Soup in this practical course. Understand how to navigate HTML structures, parse web pages, and collect data efficiently for analysis or automation. Through hands-on projects, you'll develop skills in handling real-world scraping challenges, storing extracted data, and applying web scraping techniques to research, business, or personal projects.

front-endwebdeveloperbootcamp_htmlcssjsa.human_name: The Front-End Web Developer Bootcamp: HTML, CSS, JS & React
front-endwebdeveloperbootcamp_htmlcssjsa.description_text: Become a confident front-end developer with this comprehensive bootcamp covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. Learn to build responsive, interactive websites from the ground up, mastering layout techniques, styling, scripting, and modern component-based development. Through practical projects, you'll develop the skills to create polished, professional web interfaces, gaining a strong foundation for a career in front-end web development.

pythonforgameprogramming_pygamefromatoz.human_name: Python for Game Programming: Pygame from A to Z
pythonforgameprogramming_pygamefromatoz.description_text: Learn to build your own games using Python and Pygame in this fun, project-based course. Cover essential game development concepts including graphics, animation, collision detection, and user input handling. Through hands-on projects, you'll design and build functional games from scratch, developing practical programming skills while exploring the creative side of coding in an engaging, beginner-friendly environment.

python3forbeginners.description_text: Get started with Python 3, the most widely used version of the language, in this beginner-focused course. Learn essential concepts including variables, data types, loops, conditionals, and basic functions through simple, easy-to-follow lessons. You'll build small programs, understand Python's clean syntax, and develop the fundamental skills needed to progress to more advanced programming topics. Ideal for complete beginners, this course lays the groundwork for a successful start in coding.

pythonforspatialanalysisinarcgis.human_name: Python for Spatial Analysis in ArcGIS
pythonforspatialanalysisinarcgis.description_text: Explore spatial analysis techniques using Python within ArcGIS, a leading geographic information system platform. Learn how to automate GIS workflows, analyze spatial data, and build custom tools using Python scripting. Through practical exercises, you'll develop skills in geospatial analysis, data processing, and automation, equipping you with valuable capabilities for careers in GIS, urban planning, and environmental analysis.

pythonfromscratch.description_text: Start your programming journey with this beginner-friendly course covering Python from the ground up. Learn core concepts including variables, data types, loops, conditionals, and functions while writing your first working programs. Through hands-on exercises, you'll build a solid foundation in problem-solving and logical thinking, understand Python syntax and best practices, and gain the confidence to tackle real coding challenges. Perfect for absolute beginners with no prior programming experience, this course prepares you for more advanced Python topics and practical software development.

pythondatascience.description_text: Learn how Python powers modern data science in this course covering data analysis, visualization, and statistical techniques. Master essential libraries for handling datasets, performing calculations, and creating meaningful visualizations to communicate insights. You'll develop skills in data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and interpreting results, gaining a strong foundation for pursuing data-driven roles or advancing into machine learning and analytics.

createsmartmapsinpythonandleaflet.human_name: Create Smart Maps in Python and Leaflet
createsmartmapsinpythonandleaflet.description_text: Learn to build interactive, dynamic maps using Python and the Leaflet library in this practical course. Understand how to visualize geographic data, add markers, layers, and interactive features to create engaging map-based applications. Through hands-on projects, you'll develop skills in geospatial visualization, gaining practical experience applicable to data analysis, web development, and location-based application projects.

datamanipulationinpython_masterpythonnum.human_name: Data Manipulation in Python: Master Python, Numpy & Pandas
datamanipulationinpython_masterpythonnum.description_text: Master essential data manipulation techniques using Python, NumPy, and Pandas in this hands-on course. Learn how to clean, transform, and analyze datasets efficiently, working with arrays, dataframes, and powerful data operations. Through practical exercises, you'll develop the skills to handle real-world data challenges, prepare datasets for analysis, and build a strong foundation for data science and analytics roles.

generativeaifordynamicjavawebapplication.human_name: Generative AI for Dynamic Java Web Applications with ChatGPT
generativeaifordynamicjavawebapplication.description_text: Learn how to integrate ChatGPT and generative AI into Java web applications in this practical, technology-focused course. Understand how to leverage AI-powered features to build dynamic, intelligent web applications, from generating content to enhancing user interactions. You'll gain hands-on experience combining Java development with modern AI tools, developing skills that bridge traditional web development and cutting-edge AI integration.

deeplearningandneuralnetworkspython_kera.human_name: Deep Learning & Neural Networks Python - Keras
deeplearningandneuralnetworkspython_kera.description_text: Master deep learning using Keras, one of Python's most popular neural network libraries. Learn how to build, train, and optimize neural networks for tasks like classification and prediction, while understanding key concepts such as layers, activation functions, and model tuning. Through hands-on projects, you'll gain practical experience developing deep learning models efficiently, preparing you for real-world AI and machine learning applications.

datascienceandmachinelearningwithpython.human_name: Data Science & Machine Learning With Python
datascienceandmachinelearningwithpython.description_text: Dive into the world of data science and machine learning using Python's powerful libraries and tools. Learn how to clean and analyze data, build predictive models, and apply machine learning algorithms including regression, classification, and clustering. Through practical projects, you'll gain experience with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn, developing the skills needed to extract insights from data and build real-world machine learning solutions.

pythonfordeeplearning_buildneuralnetwork.human_name: Python for Deep Learning: Build Neural Networks in Python
pythonfordeeplearning_buildneuralnetwork.description_text: Step into deep learning with this Python course focused on building and training neural networks from scratch. Learn the fundamentals of neural network architecture, activation functions, and backpropagation while implementing models using Python. Through practical exercises, you'll develop the skills to design, train, and evaluate neural networks, gaining a strong foundation for advancing into more complex deep learning applications.

mightyswitchforcehoseitdown.human_name: Mighty Switch Force! Hose It Down
mightyswitchforcehoseitdown.callout: WayForward’s award-winning Mighty Switch Force series, transformed into a pick-up-and-play puzzler!
mightyswitchforcehoseitdown.description_text:
WayForward’s award-winning Mighty Switch Force series, transformed into a pick-up-and-play puzzler!

Team up with Officer Patricia Wagon to save Tangent City from a fiery blaze! As a member of Planet Land’s Fire Brigade, your job is to douse the fire in each building — and to evacuate any Hooligan Sisters who may be trapped inside. It’s a dangerous job, but if anyone can save the city, you and Patty can!

Slide blocks around the playfield, and let loose a powerful water spray from Officer Wagon's Infinity Dousing Apparatus (err… hose). Douse all of the flames, and the stage is clear! Sounds easy, right?

Block types vary from simple slide-puzzle obstacles to full-blown brain-busters like Turnpike Blocks, Mud Blocks, and Cloak Blocks.
Each level has been lovingly crafted and is WayForward Certified, guaranteed to challenge, befuddle, and tickle your fancy.

This version includes:

-50 puzzles spread across 10 Worlds.
-Fully illustrated cutscenes
-Speed Run challenges
-An incredible soundtrack by Jake “Virt” Kaufman

rivercitygirls.description_text:
There's trouble once again on the mean streets of River City, but this time the boys are in over their heads! In this all-new entry in the legendary beat-'em-up series, hot-blooded heroes Kunio and Riki have been captured, leaving it to their hard-hitting girlfriends, Kyoko and Misako, to serve up some payback. As you punch and kick your way across town - either solo or with a friend in local co-op - you'll gain new skills, chow down on power-ups, wield an assortment of weapons, and unleash an arsenal of combos, throws, and special attacks that will leave the bad guys crying for mama - all in outrageous 16-bit style! The awesome action is punctuated by manga story panels, anime cutscenes, and an epic synth-pop soundtrack. It’s an old-school rumble for a new generation!

Key Features:
-Wild beat-'em-up action for one or two players!
-Glorious pixel-art graphics plus anime and manga cutscenes!
-Fantastic soundtrack featuring Megan McDuffee, Chipzel, Cristina Vee, Dale North, and NateWantsToBattle!
-Six large city regions to fight through, complete with shops and side quests!
-Loads of weapons, items, and abilities to power-up your heroines!
-Guest appearances by classic River City characters!

mightyswitchforce_collection.callout: Switch up the fun with four games in one!
mightyswitchforce_collection.description_text:
Switch up the fun with four games in one! As cybernetic peacekeeper Officer Patricia Wagon, you'll use your platforming skills, puzzle-solving abilities, and special level-altering Siren Helmet to protect the people of Planet Land and smash enemies into the screen! In Mighty Switch Force! and its HD remake, Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition, you'll zap foes while “switching” blocks from the foreground to the background (and vice versa) as you track down the delinquent Hooligan Sisters in each stage. Then, in Mighty Switch Force! 2, Officer Wagon trades in her Pellet Gun for a fire hose as she extinguishes a dangerous blaze and rescues would-be victims. Finally, in Mighty Switch Force! Academy, you'll put the trainees through their paces in expansive HD stages with co-op and versus modes for up to four players. The future of lighthearted law enforcement is here!

Key Features:
•Four fantastic games in one: Mighty Switch Force!, Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition, Mighty Switch Force! 2, and Mighty Switch Force! Academy
•Use your Siren Helmet to switch around level layouts and solve tricky puzzles!
•Blast enemies with your Pellet Gun and extinguish flames with your firehose!
•Encounter colorful characters like Corporal Gendarmor, Ugly Twitching Dog, and Ugly Secret Baby!
•Avoid hazards and interact with elements like Launch Blocks and Force Field Blocks to navigate more than 70 levels!
•Aim for the fastest time! Perfect for speedrunners!

shantaeadvance_riskyrevolutiondeluxeedit.human_name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution Deluxe Edition 25% off Coupon
shantaeadvance_riskyrevolutiondeluxeedit.description_text:
Get 25% off Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution Deluxe Edition in the Humble Store!

NOTE: Expires February 28th, 2027, 9pm PT. Does not stack with Humble Store sales.

Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

The Deluxe Edition of Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution adds three special bonus outfits that change Shantae’s appearance and boost her magical abilities: Sizzle Armor Costume (enhanced Fireball Power), Relic Hunter Costume (enhanced Pike Ball Power), and High Voltage Costume (enhanced Storm Puff Power)!

Key Features:

• Discover the lost chapter of the Shantae saga, fully restored and released after 20 years!
• Fight and explore using your hair-whipping ability, magic items, and belly-dance transformations (including monkey, elephant, crab, and more)!
• Spin and shift Front Yard and Back Yard playfields to create new routes and solve puzzles!
• Visit towns, battle through labyrinths, purchase upgrades, find collectables, and meet with friends like Rottytops, Sky, and Bolo!
• For the first time ever in a Shantae game, four players can compete in Battle Mode!
• Deluxe Edition includes three bonus outfits: Sizzle Armor Costume, Relic Hunter Costume, and High Voltage Costume!

rwby_arrowfell.description_text:
Dive into an explosive new RWBY action-adventure! Instantly switch between all four members of Team RWBY — Ruby Rose, Weiss Schnee, Blake Belladonna, and Yang Xiao Long — and use their signature weapons and Semblances to battle the Creatures of Grimm and other foes in side-scrolling, 2D combat and exploration! Featuring an in-canon story set during RWBY Volume 7, all-new cutscenes from the team behind the show, and an original theme song by Jeff Williams and Casey Lee Williams, RWBY: Arrowfell lets you traverse Atlas and more than 25 other areas to solve environmental puzzles, slay massive bosses, power up with Skill Points, and interact with characters such as Penny, Winter, and General Ironwood, as well as the enigmatic new team of Huntresses, Team BRIR! Only Team RWBY can protect Remnant from a mysterious new threat in RWBY: Arrowfell!

Key Features:
• Play as all four members of Team RWBY — Ruby, Weiss, Blake, and Yang — each with their own weapons and abilities! Switch between them at any time!
• Use each character's Semblances to get an edge in combat and solve puzzles!
• Featuring an original theme song by Jeff Williams with vocals by Casey Lee Williams!
• An all-new canonical story set during RWBY Volume 7 from RWBY writers Kerry Shawcross, Miles Luna, and Eddy Rivas!
• Explore a variety of nonlinear environments in Atlas, Mantle, and the surrounding areas!
• Interact with familiar characters such as Penny, Winter, General Ironwood, and the Ace Operatives, as well as new faces such as Team BRIR!
• Collect Skill Points to power up Team RWBY's stats!

shantae_riskysrevenge.description_text: Shantae: Risky’s Revenge – Director’s Cut combines all of the award-winning content from previous releases and adds even more! The pixel-based masterpiece remains intact, newly augmented with HD portrait artwork and extra challenge. New illustrations, Steam Trading Cards, Achievements, emoticons, controller support, fully configurable controls, and an unlockable Magic Mode with alternate costume round out the package. The Director’s Cut also introduces a re-imagined Warp System, perfect for speed runners and returning players alike! Play one of the most critically acclaimed handheld series of all time, now on your PC!

care_org.description_text:
Donations to support Care.org are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.
 
Founded in 1945 with the creation of the CARE Package®, CARE is a leading humanitarian organization fighting global poverty. CARE places special focus on working alongside women and girls. Equipped with the proper resources women and girls have the power to lift whole families and entire communities out of poverty. In 2022, CARE worked in over 110 countries, reaching more than 170 million people through 1,600 projects.

shantaeandthesevensirens.description_text:
Shantae is back in an all-new tropical adventure! In her fifth outing, the Half-Genie hero gains new Fusion Magic abilities to explore a vast sunken city, makes new Half-Genie friends, and battles the Seven Sirens in her biggest, most thrilling quest yet! Featuring multiple towns and more labyrinths than ever before, an awesome aquatic journey full of danger and discovery awaits!

Key Features:
-Traverse an expansive, interconnected world above and below the sea!
-Use Fusion Magic to change instantly between new creature forms!
-Belly dance to activate machinery, restore health, and more!
-Collect and power up with Monster Cards!
-Enjoy minigames, acquire magic and items, and uncover secrets!
-Gorgeously animated TV-style cutscenes!
-All-new characters and returning favorites like Rottytops, Sky, Bolo, and the nefarious pirate Risky Boots!

shantae_piratescurse.description_text:
Embark on a brand new adventure with Shantae, the hair-whipping belly dancing genie. When she loses her magic, Shantae must team up with her nemesis, the nefarious pirate Risky Boots in order to save Sequin Land from an evil curse. As a pirate, Shantae gains new weapons to advance her quest, slay monsters, battle epic bosses…and hopefully get her magic back in the bargain! But can she really trust her deadliest enemy?

The third Shantae game is the biggest yet! Beyond Sequin Land lie cursed islands and labyrinths each hiding a new piece of Pirate Gear - Flintlock Pistol, Pirate Hat, Scimitar, Risky's Boots, and even a Cannon. Upgrade Shantae's hair and weapons or unlock advanced Fighter's Moves. Locate maps, return lost Heart Squids, collect rare loot, and laugh out loud at the weird, wild, and wonderfully humorous cast of characters. Incredible high resolution artwork, unlockable Pirate-Mode, multiple endings, and an unforgettable soundtrack make this one game you won't want to miss!

spidersaurs.callout: Armed with an arsenal of awesome weapons, it's up to you (and a friend in co-op mode) to shoot your way through six levels of ferocious run-’n’-gun mayhem and send these mutant monstrosities back to the stone age.
spidersaurs.description_text:
Alert! Alert! The nightmarish dinosaur-spider hybrids known as Spidersaurs have run amok and only you (and a friend in co-op mode) can stop them! Created by InGest Corp to provide the meat and muscle that humanity needs to end world hunger, the Spidersaurs are now on the loose, leaving it to two former taste-testers – officer-in-training Adrian and punk-rocker Victoria – to use their awesome firepower to overcome six stages of ferocious run-'n'-gun action. Blast through a sweltering jungle, an infested laboratory, the heart of a live volcano, and more! The tangy food source with a bite is biting back, but by grabbing power-ups, gaining new abilities, and obliterating everything in sight, you can send these mutant monstrosities back to the stone age.

Key Features:
• Intense, Saturday-morning-cartoon-style action for one or two players — complete with theme song and epic intro from Powerhouse Animation!
• Two distinct playable characters: punk rocker Victoria and officer-in-training Adrian!
• Unleash awesome firepower — everything from spread guns and lasers to detonating footballs and bass-heavy electronica! Twelve weapons in all!
• Explosive environments including volcanoes, jungles, laboratories, and more!
• A menagerie of unique and terrifying Spidersaurs to battle!
• Unlock new abilities as you advance through the InGest Corp facility!
• Three difficulty settings: Well Done, Medium, and Rare!
• Unlockable arcade mode and speedrun mode!

shantae_halfgeniehero_ultimateedition.description_text:
Shantae embarks on her first full HD adventure! When a mysterious crime wave sweeps Sequin Land, it’s up to Half-Genie Hero Shantae to save the day! Use Shantae’s devastating Hair-Whip Attack to send monsters flying, or Belly Dance to transform into a more powerful creature form! Topple the masterminds behind each criminal caper and prepare for the ultimate showdown against Shantae’s arch nemesis - the bodacious buccaneer Risky Boots!

Key Features:

• Shantae’s trademark moves return! Dance to transform into all-new and classic creatures, or summon magical attacks! Over a dozen dances to discover in all!
• New Relic System allows players to unlock new powers and customize moves for Shantae and her many forms!
• Conquer arcade-style action stages that unfold into a full world to explore. Fast action and quest-style exploration rolled into one!
• When Shantae’s story ends, you’re just getting started! DLC Modes introduce new characters, levels, and bosses!
• Huge Bosses, humorous dialogue, and the wonderfully weird Shantae cast return, now in fully animated HD!

This all-inclusive version comes with all of the previously released DLC, Modes, and Costumes!

Save the day as belly dancing half-genie Shantae! Conquer Sequin Land as the evil Risky Boots in ‘Pirate Queen’s Quest’! Swap between Sky, Bolo, and Rottytops in ‘Friends to the End’! And finally, wall-jump as Ninja Shantae, soak up sun as Beach Shantae, serve justice as Officer Shantae!

Also includes Tinkerbat Transformation, Blue Shantae & Classic Risky costumes!

care_org.description_text:
Donations to support Care.org are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.
 
Founded in 1945 with the creation of the CARE Package®, CARE is a leading humanitarian organization fighting global poverty. CARE places special focus on working alongside women and girls. Equipped with the proper resources women and girls have the power to lift whole families and entire communities out of poverty. In 2022, CARE worked in over 110 countries, reaching more than 170 million people through 1,600 projects.

cart.description_text: Sturdy two‑wheeled cart with removable yoke and cargo bundle scatter. Prints support‑free on FDM or resin machines.

dwarfbattlerager.description_text: Armoured berserker bristling with spike plates, roaring mid‑charge. Optional helmeted head and twin‑axe arms.

longhouse.description_text:
Build your stronghold with the Long House, a grand Norse hall featuring a steep-pitched timber roof, carved gable beams, sturdy plank walls and a removable roof for interior play.

Perfect as a chieftain's seat, feast hall or village centrepiece, it brings authentic Viking-age character to any tabletop. Scaled for 28-32 mm play, the building prints in sectional slices with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency on consumer machines.

Knotted woodgrain, shingle and carved-dragon details reward washes and dry-brushing. Pair it with other Norse structures to raise a complete settlement.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

midgardserpentminiature.description_text: Coil the seas around your players with the Midgard Serpent: a 200 mm‑long leviathan curling over a rocky base. Supplied in six keyed, hollow parts and fully pre‑supported for large‑format resin printers, the sculpt showcases scale plates, horned frills and an open maw bursting with fangs. Unsupported masters and a prescaled 75 % version are included for smaller vats. Print once or a fleet—your lifetime licence never expires.

burialmound.description_text:
Set the scene with the Burial Mound, an ancient grave-barrow crowned with weathered standing stones, carved runes and a brooding entrance arch.
This atmospheric terrain piece evokes forgotten kings and restless dead, perfect as an objective marker, dungeon entrance or scatter for haunted moors. Scaled for 28-32 mm play, it prints in sectional pieces with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed with drain channels to save resin.

The textured earthwork and mossy stones reward washes and dry-brushing. Drop it onto any battlefield to add narrative weight and verticality.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited terrain prints.

goldendragon.description_text:
Dominate the table with the Golden Dragon, a magnificent winged wyrm reared on powerful haunches with jaws agape and wings flared wide. Overlapping scales, curling horns and razor talons resolve crisply on consumer resin printers, making this an unforgettable campaign boss or display centrepiece.

Sculpted for 32 mm encounters, the dragon arrives in multiple keyed parts, body, wings, head and tail with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed and reinforced for safe curing of the large components.

The dynamic pose and intricate membrane detailing reward ambitious painters.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence so this golden terror can menace as many adventuring parties as you wish.

campfiresceneset.description_text:
Complete campsite diorama featuring flickering‑log firepit, Ring‑of‑Stones base, bedrolls, cooking tripod, stewpots and scatter logs.

Everything is scaled to 28–32 mm minis and provided in both print‑in‑place (all props on one plate) and standalone STL options.

Pre‑supported files use minimal contact points to keep surfaces clean; hollowed logs reduce material. A one‑stop download for wilderness encounters and storytelling vignettes.

woodlandmonsters_setof3.description_text:
This trio of sylvan terrors—Tree Ent, Vine Wraith and Bog Crawler—emerges from the forest with twisted bark textures and creeping roots.

Sculpted for 32 mm encounters, the monsters stand 65–90 mm tall atop integrated scenic bases.
Pre‑supported and unsupported files are included; each model prints in two to three keyed parts for painting access.

Add them as boss fights, druid summons or terrain scatter with unlimited personal prints.

potionshop.description_text:
Stock your town with the Potion Shop, an enchanting alchemist's storefront brimming with bottle-lined shelves, a hanging sign, mortar-and-pestle details and a timber-framed facade.

The removable roof reveals a detailed interior ready for spellcasting NPCs and mysterious side-quests. Scaled for 28-32 mm tabletop play, the building prints in sectional slices with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency on consumer machines.

Mix-and-match with other shops to build a magical market district. Crisp glasswork, woodgrain and signage textures reward painters. A story-rich centrepiece for urban adventures.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

highelves_horsecrew.description_text:
Charge into battle with the High Elves Horse Crew, an elegant mounted unit pairing noble riders with finely caparisoned steeds.

Flowing manes, layered scale-mail and tasselled banners capture the grace of the elven cavalry, while spears and crested helms add martial flair. Scaled for 28-32 mm gaming, the set arrives in keyed parts, rider, mount and accessories with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files for clean resin prints.

Hollowed bodies and reinforced legs ensure stable curing on consumer machines. Perfect for flanking manoeuvres, command stands or display pieces, this crew brings speed and splendour to any high-elf force.

Includes a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

vikingporthouse.description_text: Waterside warehouse with dock posts and cargo stacks. Modular pier extension lets you build full harbour scenes.

paladinaasimar.description_text: Haloed champion clad in celestial plate, longsword raised in righteous challenge. Layered armour panels, angelic sigils and flowing cape all resolve crisply on consumer resin printers thanks to thin but sturdy supports. Includes alt‑helmeted head and separate shield arm for kit‑bashing.

tacticalsquad.description_text: Core infantry unit with modular rifles, axes and banner. Squad leader has swap‑out head and power‑fist options.

warforgedfighter.description_text: Arcane‑steel construct advancing with greatsword. Interlocking plate segments, glowing‑core chest and gear‑motif base: perfect for washes and edge highlights.

kenkurogue.description_text: Knife‑wielding corvid skulker in layered leathers. Feather textures recessed for sharp prints; cloak underside hollowed to save resin. Choice of hood‑up or hood‑down head sculpts in the zip.

vikingroundhouse.description_text: Residential hut featuring timber‑plank walls, thatch roof and functional doorway. Roof halves removable for interior access.

bedset.description_text: Carved four‑poster bed with draped curtains, pillow stack and folded quilt. Prints in two hollow halves.

orcberserker.description_text: Savage orc mid‑leap, cleaver raised high. Base features shattered shields and skulls for narrative impact.

heavyassaultsquad.description_text: Armour‑plated juggernauts wielding rotary cannons and heat shields. Prints flawlessly at 0.03 mm layers; keyed arm sockets for pose swaps.

vikingchurch.description_text: Stave‑style sanctuary complete with removable roof and interior pews. Prints in sectional slices for any consumer resin printer.

minotaurwarrior.description_text: Horned labyrinth guardian gripping double‑bladed greataxe. Musculature and fur maps reward dry‑brushing.

orc_blacksmith.description_text:
Add grit to your warband with the Orc Blacksmith, a hulking greenskin smith mid-strike at his anvil, sparks flying from a crude but powerful weapon-in-progress.

Muscled arms, tusked grimace and a soot-stained apron capture brutal craftsmanship perfect for orc encampments or quest-giver NPCs. Scaled for 32 mm play, the model arrives in keyed parts with both pre-supported and raw STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency.

Crisp leather, iron and hide textures reward washes and dry-brushing on consumer MSLA machines. Use him to forge narrative around orc war-camps, weapon-shops or boss lairs.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

snipersquad.description_text: Long‑range marksmen with anti‑materiel rifles and deployable camo cloaks. Optional bipod‑down parts included.

halflingthief.description_text: Clever burglar mid‑sprint with loot bag and lock‑picks. Supported at just 28 mm tall yet retains crisp facial features; unsupported file supplied for custom scaling.

tortureset.description_text: Dungeon accessories including rack, iron maiden, shackles and branding brazier. Each prop pre‑supported.

vikingfightingpit.description_text: Sunken arena with timber palisade, spectator stands and bone‑strewn floor. Perfect for gladiator side‑quests.

demolitionsquad.description_text: Explosive experts with breacher shields, remote charges and wrist‑fuse igniters. Modelled smoke plume effect supplied separately.

aarakocra.description_text:
Take flight with the Aarakocra, a noble bird-folk warrior poised mid-stride with outstretched wings and a hunting spear at the ready.

Sculpted for 32 mm play, this avian adventurer captures every layered feather, taloned grip and keen-eyed glare in razor-sharp detail. The model arrives in two keyed parts, body and wing assembly with both pre-supported and raw STL files for hassle-free resin printing.

Perfect as a player character, sky-borne scout NPC or exotic encounter, it prints cleanly on consumer MSLA machines and rewards painters with crisp plumage textures ideal for vibrant washes.

Includes a lifetime personal licence so you can print your flock as often as your campaign demands.

dwarfwizard.description_text: Runesmith sage clutching spellbook and rune‑hammer. Cloak embossed with Khazad script; separate smoke‑spell effect included.

highelves_theslayer.description_text:
Field a deadly duellist with The Slayer, a lithe high-elf warrior caught mid-lunge with twin blades flashing and a flowing cloak trailing behind.
Sleek scale-armour, braided hair and an intense expression capture elven martial precision in a dynamic action pose.
Sculpted for 32 mm play, the model arrives in keyed parts with both pre-supported and raw STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency.
Crisp armour edges and fabric folds reward washes and edge-highlighting on consumer MSLA machines.

Ideal as a unit champion, character model or skirmish hero, The Slayer brings speed and lethality to any high-elf force.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

highelvesprince.description_text:
Lead your host with the High Elves Prince, a regal commander in ornate scale-armour and flowing cloak, sword raised to rally the line.

Filigreed pauldrons, a crested helm and an embossed shield capture noble elven majesty, rewarding dedicated painters with abundant surface detail.
Sculpted for 32 mm heroic scale, the model splits into keyed parts with both pre-supported and raw STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency.
Print cleanly on consumer MSLA machines and anchor your high-elf army with a charismatic leader. Ideal as a command stand, character model or display centrepiece.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence so the prince can lead as many battles as you wish.

birdmonk.description_text: Grace in motion: this avian martial‑artist stands poised on one talon, wind‑ruffled robes sweeping around feathered limbs. Designed for 32 mm play, the model arrives in two keyed parts with both pre‑supported and raw STL files. Perfect as an Aarakocra PC, NPC mentor or exotic boss encounter.

abandonedbuildingspack_setof5.description_text:
Transform any tabletop into a forsaken hamlet with five modular ruins featuring shattered timber frames, cracked stone foundations and printable interiors.

Walls cap at 120 mm to fit most resin vats, and each piece is hollowed with drain channels to save resin.

Mix‑and‑match floor plates allow endless board configurations while keyed joins ensure easy assembly.

Pre‑supported files plus unsupported masters give you complete control under The Master Forge lifetime licence.

halforcmerchant.description_text: World‑weary trader hefting cargo crate and ledger, ideal as quest‑giver NPC. Robust folds, coin‑pouch details and removable display base included.

humandemonhunter.description_text: Leather‑clad hunter brandishing rune‑pistol and silvered blade, dynamic trench‑coat swirl ideal for OSL.

rivermill.description_text:
Set the scene with the River Mill, a picturesque waterside mill featuring a turning wheel on a printable axle, stone foundation, timber upper storey and a removable roof for interior access.

Perfect as a village landmark, ambush site or objective, this terrain piece evokes pastoral fantasy settings with rich character. Scaled for 28-32 mm play, it prints in sectional pieces with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed with drain channels to save resin.

Weathered stone, woodgrain and waterwheel textures reward washes and dry-brushing. Pair it with riverbanks and bridges to build a complete waterside scene.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

humanking.description_text: Stalwart monarch on lion‑carved throne base. Throne provided as separate STL for standalone terrain use.

weaponry.description_text: Racks of swords, spears, maces and shields—perfect armoury scatter. Files arranged both single‑part and separated.

donorschoose.description_text:
Payments to DonorsChoose are made via the PayPal Giving Fund.

Founded in 2000 by a Bronx history teacher, DonorsChoose has raised more than $510 million for America's classrooms. Teachers come to DonorsChoose to request the materials and experiences they need most for their classrooms, and donors give to the projects that inspire them. More than 2.5 million people and partners have funded 870,000 projects on the site, reaching 21 million students and making DonorsChoose the leading platform for supporting U.S. public schools. DonorsChoose is the only crowdfunding platform that vets each request, delivers materials directly to schools, and captures the impact of every funded project with photos, thank yous, and a cost report showing how each dollar was spent. Learn more at www.donorschoose.org.

*DonorsChoose was not involved in the selection of the content in this promotion and the views, opinions, and ideas expressed in the games are not endorsed by, and do not reflect or represent the views and opinions of DonorsChoose.

mountaingiant.description_text: Looming 130 mm titan hefting boulder club; skin etched with cliff‑face cracks. Supported and hollowed for safe curing.

highelflionclanfighter.description_text:
Stand proud with the High Elf Lion Clan Fighter, an elite warrior clad in lion-pelt cloak and ornate scale armour, blade poised in a confident guard stance.

Intricate mane detailing, embossed shield heraldry and flowing tabard reward dedicated painters with abundant surface texture. Sculpted for 32 mm play, the model splits into keyed parts with both pre-supported and raw STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency.

Ideal as a unit champion, character model or display centrepiece, this noble fighter anchors any high-elf battle-line with regal presence.

Prints reliably on consumer MSLA machines and comes with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited tabletop musters.

elfarcher_tmf.description_text: Longbow champion in flowing leafmail drawing fletched arrow. Comes with quiver‑on‑hip and quiver‑on‑back variants.

vikingwindmill.description_text: Rotating mill blades supplied on printable axle; stone base and timber upper storey print separately.

vikingraiderlongship.description_text:
A 10.5‑inch long drakkar brimming with Norse flavour: carved dragon prow, Viking shields, working oar ports and removable mast.

The hull prints in segmented, keyed sections sized for mid‑size resin vats; interior planking is recessed for easy dry‑brushing.

Optional stretcher bars let you convert to an on‑table terrain piece or a seaworthy gaming prop.

Pre‑supported variants included—just slice, print, glue and set sail.

valhallagate.description_text: Grand portal crowned with rune‑arch and shield murals, scaled for 28–32 mm minis. Double doors are separate, printable pieces.

outhouse.description_text:
Add humble charm to your settlement with the Outhouse, a rickety timber privy complete with crescent-moon door cut-out, weathered planking and a slumping shingle roof.

This compact scatter piece brings everyday realism to villages, farmsteads and frontier towns, and makes for a great comedic objective or hiding spot. Scaled for 28-32 mm play, it prints quickly support-free on FDM or resin machines, with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files included.

Knotted woodgrain and gappy boards reward washes and weathering. A tiny but characterful addition that fills out any tabletop scene.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

butchershop.description_text:
Flesh out your town with the Butcher Shop, a characterful medieval storefront complete with hanging meat, chopping block, awning and timber-framed walls.
The removable roof reveals a detailed interior ready for shopkeeper NPCs and grisly side-quests. Scaled for 28-32 mm tabletop play, the building prints in sectional slices with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency on consumer machines.

Mix-and-match with other market stalls to build a bustling village square. Weathered planking and shingle textures reward washes and edge-highlighting. A vivid centrepiece for urban encounters.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence so you can populate entire settlements from a single download.

hobgoblinartificer.description_text: Armoured tinkerer with arc‑pistol and modular backpack forge. Mechanical limbs, tool pouches and glowing rune‑cores make great NMM or OSL practice. Model splits at waist and backpack for easy airbrushing.

firbolgcleric.description_text: Gentle forest giant wielding rune‑etched staff and crystal focus. Layered leaf‑cloak, carved totem accessories and a serene expression reward dedicated painters. Prints in three keyed sections, each pre‑supported and hollowed for resin efficiency.

dwarvenking.description_text:
Command the mountain halls with the Dwarven King, a regal monarch enthroned in rune-etched plate armour, war-axe resting at his side and a braided beard cascading over an ornate breastplate.

Sculpted for 32 mm heroic scale, every gemstone, forge-mark and knotwork engraving resolves crisply on consumer resin printers.
The model splits into keyed sections for painting access and arrives with both pre-supported and raw STL files, hollowed to conserve resin.

Ideal as a campaign boss, faction leader or display centrepiece, this stoic ruler anchors any dwarf army or throne-room diorama.

Includes a lifetime personal licence so the king can reign over as many tables as you like.

stormgiant.description_text: Sky‑borne monarch cloaked in thundercloud cape, trident crackling with energy. Prints in 9 keyed parts for easy painting.

lizardfolkranger.description_text: Scale‑armoured hunter drawing recurve bow, quiver of bone‑fletched arrows, optional spear arm. Split across torso and tail for support‑free interior surfaces.

zealotbarbarian.description_text: Bare‑chested fanatic swinging twin great‑axes. Includes optional fur cloak and alternate shouting head.

treehouse.description_text: Elevated woodland dwelling with rope bridge segment, hollow trunk interior and lookout deck. Modular stilts fit any terrain board.

frostgiant.description_text: Ice‑forged conqueror towering at 115 mm, wielding runic great‑sword and glacier shield. Snow drift base supplied.

balistarcanonandcrew_dwarfarmy.description_text:
Bring siege firepower to the field with the Balistar Cannon & Crew, a heavy dwarf war engine manned by three industrious gunners.

The bolt-throwing cannon features turning gears, riveted iron plating and a stout timber carriage, while the crew load, aim and brace with characterful poses. Scaled for 28-32 mm rank-and-file gaming, the set ships in keyed, pre-supported parts plus unsupported masters for flexible resin printing.

Hollowed components and clean wall thickness ensure efficient curing on consumer MSLA machines. A must-have artillery piece for dwarf battle-lines, fortress defences or narrative scenarios.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited regiment-scale prints.

carnivalset.description_text:
Bring festivity to the table with the Carnival Set, a lively collection of fairground props including striped tents, market stalls, banners, barrels and scatter decorations.

Perfect for travelling-fair encounters, town celebrations or atmospheric urban dressing, every piece is scaled for 28-32 mm play and supplied in both pre-supported and unsupported STL files.

Hollowed canvas and timber components keep resin use efficient on consumer MSLA machines, while crisp fabric folds and woodgrain textures reward painters. Mix-and-match the modular pieces to lay out a complete carnival in minutes. A versatile, story-rich terrain bundle.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

drowassassin.description_text: Shadow‑stalker balanced on stalagmite, dual poisoned daggers ready. Includes alt posing arm with hand‑crossbow.

halfelfqueen.description_text: Regal sovereign on gem‑inlaid base, sceptre raised. Flowing gown drapes designed for clean support removal.

animalcompanionpack_setof5.description_text:
Animal Companion Pack gathers five faithful familiars—wolf, bear, panther, hawk and owl—each sculpted at crisp 32 mm heroic scale.

Supplied in both pre‑supported and clean STL files, every creature is keyed to scenic bases and test‑printed on 8 K MSLA machines for plug‑and‑play success.

Perfect as ranger beasts, druid's wild‑shape options or painting projects, this set lets you populate a bestiary with a single download and a lifetime personal licence.

dragonbornknight.description_text: Scaled paladin in drake‑themed armour, tower shield and flame‑engraved longsword. Prints in four keyed pieces; horns reinforced with internal pegs.

giantsandheroesbustcollection_setof8bust.human_name: Giants and Heroes Bust Collection - Set of 8 Busts
giantsandheroesbustcollection_setof8bust.description_text:
Eight epic busts—Frost Giant, Storm Herald, Mountain Giant, Zealot Barbarian, Orc Berserker, Minotaur Warrior, Dwarf Battlerager and Valkyrie—capture larger‑than‑life personalities in showcase scale.

Each bust is hollowed, keyed and pre‑supported for resin efficiency while retaining razor‑sharp detail in skin, armour and braided hair.

Ideal for display painting or campaign props, the collection comes with clean meshes, printer‑friendly wall thicknesses and a lifetime personal licence.

plaguedoctor.description_text: Dark‑age medic gripping torch and apothecary satchel. Beak mask, stitched leathers and potion vials textured for contrast. Includes alt hand with scalpel for horror scenarios.

stable_tmf.description_text:
Complete your settlement with the Stable, a rustic timber horse-barn featuring stall partitions, a hayloft, double doors and a removable roof for full interior access.

Ideal as a coaching-inn outbuilding, ambush location or atmospheric town dressing, this terrain piece adds everyday life to any fantasy village.
Scaled for 28-32 mm play, it prints in sectional slices with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency on consumer machines.

Weathered planking, straw and ironwork textures reward washes and dry-brushing. Mix-and-match with other rural buildings to build a complete homestead. Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

infiltrationsquad.description_text: Five covert‑ops Brokk‑r troops with suppressors, hacking rigs and stealth packs. Modular heads and weapon options, fully pre‑supported and hollowed.

storehouse_v1.description_text: Two‑storey timber warehouse with ladder, hatch and hinged doors. Floors slot in without glue for playable interiors.

valkyrie.description_text: Winged shield‑maiden descending with spear and round shield. Optional helmet plume and scenic rock base parts.

gnomebarbarian.description_text: Don’t judge his size—this ferocious gnome swings a double‑headed axe as big as he is. Dynamic overhead strike pose, fur‑mantle texture and braided beard detail guaranteed to hold paint washes. Pre‑supported STL plus unsupported master included.

gnomewarlock.description_text: Arcane prodigy casting eldritch blast; swirling energy effect prints in transparent resin beautifully.

gallows.description_text: Grim wooden gallows with working trap‑door platform and rope piece. Ideal for frontier towns or horror scenarios.

berserkerdwarves_setof5.description_text:
Unleash fury with the Berserker Dwarves, a set of five bare-chested warriors charging headlong with twin axes, war-hammers and roaring battle-cries.

Each miniature bristles with knotted muscle, braided beards and spiked bracers, frozen in dynamic combat poses ideal for rank-and-file units or champion models. Sculpted at 28-32 mm scale, the set includes both pre-supported and raw STL files with keyed joints for painting access and resin-friendly hollowing.

Print flawlessly on consumer MSLA machines and reinforce your dwarf army with a unit that hits as hard as it looks.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence so you can muster an entire warband from a single download.

storehouse_v2.description_text: Alternate stone‑foundation storehouse with raised loading dock and detachable roof. Prints in sectional pieces.

smithhouse.description_text:
Anchor your village with the Smith House, a sturdy blacksmith's dwelling combining a stone-and-timber forge with a comfortable living quarter and a removable roof for interior play.

Detailed chimney, workbench and shuttered windows make it both functional terrain and an atmospheric quest location.
Scaled for 28-32 mm tabletop gaming, the building prints in sectional slices with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency on consumer machines.
Crisp masonry, thatch and woodgrain textures reward painters. Mix-and-match with other buildings to grow a bustling settlement. A versatile centrepiece for town encounters.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

woodencrane.description_text: Functional dockside crane with winch gear and hanging cargo net. Joints engineered to glue flush or pin.

bonebreaker_dwarfarmy.description_text:
Crush the line with the Bone Breaker, a towering dwarf champion hefting a massive two-handed maul over spiked plate armour.

Knotted muscle, riveted pauldrons and a snarling battle-helm make this hero a commanding presence at the front of any warband. Sculpted at 32 mm heroic scale, the model arrives in keyed parts with both pre-supported and raw STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency and reinforced at stress points.

Print cleanly on consumer MSLA machines and lead your dwarf army with a brutal melee specialist built to smash through shield-walls.

Includes a lifetime personal licence so the Bone Breaker can anchor as many tables as your campaigns require.

cogship.description_text:
Set sail with the Cog Ship, a sturdy single-masted medieval merchant vessel featuring planked hull, raised fore and stern castles, rigging points and a removable mast.

Ideal as a harbour centrepiece, naval encounter or seafaring terrain prop, the ship prints in segmented, keyed sections sized for mid-size resin vats. Interior decking is recessed for easy dry-brushing, and both pre-supported and unsupported STL files are included for flexible printing on consumer machines.

Weathered timber and rope textures reward washes and weathering. Convert it to a gaming objective or display model.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence so you can build a whole trading fleet from one download.

stormherald.description_text: Storm‑charged warrior with lightning‑wreathed hammer and billowing cape. Separate lightning effect prints in clear resin.

changelingspy.description_text: Shapeshifter mid‑transition: half‑masked face and morphing limbs. Optional fully revealed and fully disguised heads provided.

chariotcrew_highelves.description_text:
Thunder across the field with the High Elves Chariot Crew, a swift war-chariot drawn by spirited steeds and manned by noble riders wielding spears and bows.

Ornate scrollwork, scaled barding and fluttering banners capture elven elegance in motion, while spinning wheels and a sturdy axle ground the piece in tabletop practicality. Scaled for 28-32 mm gaming, the set arrives in keyed parts with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed for resin efficiency.

Reinforced wheel spokes and horse legs ensure stable curing on consumer machines. A spectacular centrepiece or fast-attack unit for any high-elf force.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

armourer.description_text:
Outfit your settlement with the Armourer, a hard-working blacksmith bent over his anvil mid-strike, hammer raised above a glowing blade.

Detailed leather apron, muscled forearms and a workbench strewn with tongs, helmets and breastplates make this the perfect quest-giver NPC or atmospheric town dressing. Scaled for 28-32 mm tabletop play, the model comes in keyed parts with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files for clean, reliable resin prints.

Hollowed where possible to save material, the sculpt holds fine detail in chainmail rings and tool textures. A versatile centrepiece for forges, armouries and market scenes.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited prints.

boltthrowercrew_highelves.description_text:
Pin the enemy with the High Elves Bolt Thrower Crew, a precision war machine operated by two graceful elven artillerists.
The repeater bolt-thrower features carved limbs, taut bowstrings and a filigreed frame, while the crew aim and reload in characterful poses. Scaled for 28-32 mm rank-and-file gaming, the set ships in keyed, pre-supported parts plus unsupported masters for flexible resin printing.

Hollowed components and clean wall thickness keep curing efficient on consumer MSLA machines. A vital ranged support piece for high-elf battle-lines, fortress defences or narrative skirmishes.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence so you can field a full artillery battery from one download.

bathtub.description_text: Claw‑foot tub, stack of towels, soap dish and splash insert—everything you need for a medieval bathhouse scene.

taverncounterset.description_text: Bar counter, ale kegs, mugs, shelves and cash box for instant inn dressing. Pegged joins for sturdy assembly.

mausoleum.description_text:
Haunt your battlefield with the Mausoleum, a gothic stone tomb crowned with statuary, iron gates and weathered relief carvings.

This brooding terrain piece serves as a graveyard centrepiece, dungeon entrance or objective marker for undead encounters and horror scenarios.
Scaled for 28-32 mm play, it prints in sectional pieces with both pre-supported and unsupported STL files, hollowed with drain channels to save resin.
Mossy masonry, cracked statues and rusted ironwork reward washes and dry-brushing on consumer machines.
Drop it into cemeteries, ruined estates or cursed crypts to add narrative atmosphere and verticality.

Supplied with a lifetime personal licence for unlimited terrain prints.

donorschoose.description_text:
Payments to DonorsChoose are made via the PayPal Giving Fund.

Founded in 2000 by a Bronx history teacher, DonorsChoose has raised more than $510 million for America's classrooms. Teachers come to DonorsChoose to request the materials and experiences they need most for their classrooms, and donors give to the projects that inspire them. More than 2.5 million people and partners have funded 870,000 projects on the site, reaching 21 million students and making DonorsChoose the leading platform for supporting U.S. public schools. DonorsChoose is the only crowdfunding platform that vets each request, delivers materials directly to schools, and captures the impact of every funded project with photos, thank yous, and a cost report showing how each dollar was spent. Learn more at www.donorschoose.org.

*DonorsChoose was not involved in the selection of the content in this promotion and the views, opinions, and ideas expressed in the games are not endorsed by, and do not reflect or represent the views and opinions of DonorsChoose.

reverseengineeringarmv8-asystems.description_text:
Key Features

  • Master key aspects of Armv8-A, including register, exception handling, and TrustZone
  • Build new reversing skills for kernel binaries, such as *.ko and vmlinux, for firmware analysis
  • Understand Armv8-A's latest security features
  • Purchase of the print or Kindle book includes a free PDF eBook

Who this book is for

This book is for professionals and enthusiasts interested in reverse engineering and debugging on Armv8-A-based devices. It is especially useful for system software engineers, security consultants, and ethical hackers expanding their binary analysis expertise. To get the most out of this book, you should have a basic understanding of the C programming language. Familiarity with computer architecture, Linux systems, and security concepts will be a definite advantage.

architectinghigh-performanceembeddedsyst.description_text:
Key Features

Who this book is for

This book is for software developers, IoT engineers, and anyone who wants to understand the process of developing high-performance embedded systems. You’ll also find this book useful if you want to learn about the fundamentals of FPGA development and all aspects of firmware development in C and C++. Familiarity with the C language, digital circuits, and electronic soldering is necessary to get started.

zephyrrtoscookbook.description_text:
Key Features

  • Configure features with Kconfig and describe hardware with DeviceTree
  • Develop portable, scalable systems for industrial and IoT devices using Zephyr subsystems and the device driver model

Who this book is for

This book is for embedded developers and engineers transitioning to Zephyr from traditional RTOSes, bare-metal environments, or embedded Linux. It is aimed at readers with experience in embedded C who want to adopt Zephyr as a scalable platform for building portable systems that can be deployed consistently across multiple boards and development teams.

practicaldebuggingforembeddedarmsystems.human_name: Practical Debugging for Embedded ARM Systems
practicaldebuggingforembeddedarmsystems.description_text:

  • Learn techniques for analyzing bootloaders, RTOS, and memory issues
  • Apply practical debugging workflows based on ARM Cortex-M firmware examples

Who this book is for

This book is ideal for embedded developers and firmware engineers working with ARM-based systems who want to improve their debugging workflows. It is not just a beginner’s guide, but a practical resource for those already familiar with building and programming embedded firmware. Whether you’re debugging bootloaders, analyzing RTOS behavior, or using advanced hardware tools, this book will help you streamline your workflow and solve complex issues with confidence.

insidersguidetoarmcortex-mdevelopment.human_name: The Insider's Guide to Arm Cortex-M Development
insidersguidetoarmcortex-mdevelopment.description_text:
Key Features

  • Learn how to select the best Cortex-M hardware, software, and tools for your project

Who this book is for

This book is for practicing engineers and students working with embedded and IoT systems who want to quickly learn how to develop quality software for Arm Cortex-M processors without reading long technical manuals. If you’re looking for a book that explains C or assembly language programming for the purpose of creating a single application or mastering a type of programming such as digital signal processing algorithms, then this book is NOT for you. A basic understanding of embedded hardware and software, along with general C programming skills will assist with understanding the concepts covered in this book.

embeddedsystemsarchitecture_2ndedition.description_text:

linuxdevicedriverdevelopment.description_text:

Electronic hackers and hobbyists interested in Linux kernel development as well as anyone looking to interact with the platform using GPIO, IIO, and input subsystems will also find this book useful.

hands-onrtoswithmicrocontrollers_2ndedit.description_text:

fpgaprogramminghandbook_2nded.description_text:

Who this book is for

FPGA designers looking to gain hands-on experience with real-world projects will also find this book useful. Whether you are new to FPGA development or seeking to enhance your skills, this book provides a solid foundation and practical experience in FPGA design.

embeddedlinuxsecurityhandbook.description_text:

masteringembeddedlinuxdevelopment.description_text:

Anyone who develops hardware for Linux will find something useful in this book. But before you get started, you will need a solid grasp of the POSIX standard, C programming, and shell scripting.

risc-varchitectureanddspprocessordesign.human_name: RISC-V Architecture and DSP Processor Design

Who this book is for

This book is for computer architects, embedded systems engineers, DSP engineers, and RTL/FPGA designers interested in RISC-V processor implementation. It is also suitable for graduate students and researchers in computer architecture, VLSI, and SoC design who want to explore the SpringCore DSP architecture and its implementation. Familiarity with digital logic and processor architecture will help readers get the most from this book.

This book is designed for software developers, computer engineering and computer science students, system designers, and technical professionals seeking a clear understanding of modern computer architecture. It also suits general readers eager to understand how modern computing devices work. Readers working with PCs, mobile devices, cloud platforms, embedded systems, and AI workloads will gain practical insight to guide better design and performance decisions.

Readers should have C programming experience and a basic grasp of kernel concepts. Ideal for those wanting practical, project-based guidance on leveraging frameworks such as PCI, ALSA SoC, V4L2, and power management to build production-grade drivers.
